authority: #K2-242 sec.3.4 item (2): one-page READ-ONLY, ZERO-COMPUTATION provenance audit of the exit-spacing rule. Four columns per rule: name / source / frozen? / relation to the other in-register gates.
audited_rule: 'exit slot must be >=2 lattice cells (Manhattan) from every other lane's exit slot'  (R613 sec.2 / R632 sec.1 rule (a))

sources_checked.result: no via/exit/spacing rule. jlc_hdi_capability.yaml has via_hole_to_hole 0.2mm, min_via_diameter 0.25mm, copper_edge_clearance 0.2mm; manifest.k2.yaml density_and_clearance = 10mm-cell footprint density + min_copper_clearance >= 0.100mm. NONE concerns exit slots.
no exit-spacing rule. vias.std = drill 0.2 / outer 0.35 / annular_ring_min 0.075; high_speed = max 2 vias per line. corridors[] declares the EAST_CHIP_TO_J2 band tracks_y (In2.Cu) only.
no exit/via spacing rule (channel_alloc escape_check uses via_jogs_x/y, keepout 0.37, half_track 0.1025 - none is an exit-slot spacing).

HAS via rules, but NOT an exit-slot rule: clearance.via_via (copper edge, required = max(netclass)=0.175mm for PCIe85), hole_clearance.min=0.25mm (drill edge to copper edge). geometry_translation: via/via centre distance >= required + (od1+od2)/2.

gate_vias judges VIAS only: via-vs-obstacle seg (>= VR+seg_r+hw), via-vs-obstacle via, via-vs-pad, via-vs-OTHER-LANE-TRACK (>= VR+hw), via-via different nets (>= VIA_SEP), via-vs-other-lane A/B anchors. It contains NO exit-slot term.

VIA_R, VIA_DRILL = 0.175, 0.1 ; VR = max(VIA_R+0.175, VIA_DRILL+HOLE_CLR) = 0.35 ; VIA_SEP = 2.0*VR = 0.70mm. => VIA_SEP is a DERIVED family constant (2x a max-of-two-derived radius), not a written rule.
the only registered-style gate over exit cells requires exit_cell to be DISTINCT (no distance term at all).

audit_verdict.chain_of_custody: VIA_SEP=0.7mm (derived family constant) -> /P=0.435 = 1.61 -> rounded up to '>=2 cells' by the ENG in R613 sec.2 -> reused as an exit-slot gate in R613/R632. The supervisor's #K2-234 sec.3.3(a) wording ('reassign to a cell >=2 apart from the neighbouring lane') inherited the ENG's own number; #K2-234 sec.3.4(a) had used '>=2' for VIA positions, a different object.
audit_verdict.frozen_point: NO - absent from criteria/, SPEC_k2_v4.json, route_model_config.json and the frozen drc_rules.json
audit_verdict.relation_to_in_register_gates: OBJECT MISMATCH + NOT FAITHFUL. (i) The in-register gates (gate_vias / exact_gate) judge vias and per-layer track pitch; they do not judge exit cells. (ii) As a proxy the >=2 Manhattan test is not equivalent to what gate_vias measures: the diagonal neighbour (1,1) passes >=2 but is 0.615mm < VIA_SEP 0.70mm, while some cells rejected by >=2 are legal under the frozen clearance. It is simultaneously too loose and too strict.
audit_verdict.classification: (1a) self-added / derived PRE-FILTER PROXY, NOT an in-register rule body
audit_verdict.consequence: per #K2-242 sec.3.4(1a) the constraint is WITHDRAWN; the sole physical judge for exit/DRAWING legality is the in-register gate set (gate_vias + exact_gate + endpoints + <=2 via pairs). The distinct-exit-cell requirement stays (physical necessity: two nets may not share copper at the same cell on the same layer).

preserved_in_register.note: kept as-is; applies to VIAS, not to exit cells
